changes_this_run.reason: Remove generic post-semantic-freeze head polling from the checker-v2 critical path. Complete bounded checker authoring/precommit/readback/control execution under the frozen root/config tuple, then perform one fail-closed exact root/config identity revalidation immediately before any current positive Phase-1 acceptance claim.

before_after_rationale.before: Config7 said unrelated main drift was not a stop, but evaluation still polled/compared generic main after semantic freeze and stopped before producing checker-v2 whenever concurrent workers advanced the repository.
before_after_rationale.after: Config8 forbids generic-head polling between semantic freeze and the first checker/control completion, requires durable precommit before first checker execution, and moves exact two-authority freshness verification to an acceptance-publication barrier. If authority changed, completed role-local work is retained as diagnostic but cannot be used as current positive acceptance evidence.
before_after_rationale.why_this_reduces_time_to_root: The pool writes frequently by design. Moving freshness from a continuously-triggered work-abort gate to a single acceptance barrier removes a starvation loop without allowing stale authority to produce a current acceptance claim or consuming newer-head semantics.
